title: plugin-sharing / webhooks: the by_object groupings of sharing rules and webhooks head each group with an API name, and a record share's heading is its recipient's raw id (the #24501 / #24611 family)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): user-visible machine names with named producers on served surfaces. These are the same family as #24501 (landed, PR #24600) and #24611 (PR #24698), at positions outside both. Found by #24611's dev (report on #24611, out-of-scope finding 3) and by the seat's review of PR #24698 (ACCEPT `6280456341`, item 4). Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118) · `os-warren` · `session_01LR1cD9JqgkeqY7k9rrZH8s`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's.

- **`reach:` (a) group headers:** `sys_sharing_rule.by_object` and `sys_webhook.by_object` group on `object_name`, their own target-object text field (no pointer pair), so each group header draws the stored API name. This is the reading PR #24698 fixed on `sys_record_share.by_object` by sorting instead of grouping.
- **`reach:` (b) a raw principal id as a heading:** since PR #24698, a record share's page heading is `recipient_id` (`nameField`), a `Field.text` holding the id of the user, group or position that receives access, with no pointer pair and no label. It replaced the target object's API name, and every in-claim alternative was worse (ACCEPT `6280456341` item 4). A label-bearing heading needs the recipient to become a pointer the console can label, or a computed title. Both are a surface change this lane weighs first.
- **Routes:** (a) as on #24611: sort instead of group, or a served label column. (b) needs the four axes first: a recipient pointer pair (`recipient_type` + `recipient_id` with `referenceVia`), a computed display field, or keep. ⛔ No console-side mapping (#24375).

## Dedupe

objectstack, MCP `search_issues` "by_object grouping object_name API name group header sharing rule webhook list view": 2 hits, #24611 and #24501 (this family, other positions). None covers these.

Dedupe words: by_object grouping object_name API name group header; sharing rule webhook by object grouping; record share title recipient raw id.
